headline: One picture, 223 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 223 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 223 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.004 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 01f283bfc1ba on 144 works, a8d3cb565139 on 79 works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (223).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
